Vineeta and Others --Appellants
 Versus

Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C. J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. Yogesh Kumar Pacholia, Mr. Tilak Ram 
and Mr. Saurabh Budhori, learned counsel for the
appellants.
2. Shri Yogesh Kumar Pacholia, learned counsel 
for the appellants very fairly states that the instant 
appeal is not maintainable under Section 19 of the 
Contempt of Courts Act, 1971. He however, 
submits that it may be treated to be a Special 
Appeal under Chapter VIII Rule 5 of the High 
Courts Rule.
3. In view of the prayer made, learned counsel 
for the appellants is permitted to amend the cause 
title during course of the day.
4. Office is directed to register the instant appeal 
as a Special Appeal and list it before the 
appropriate Bench on Monday i.e. 12.10.2026. 
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
